title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: share agents with a Microsoft Teams team
summary: The briefing is held because its assurance that no administrator action is required is not documented. The roadmap facts, sharing controls and preview automation are supported; the absence of a dedicated Teams-sharing switch does not establish that no administrative prerequisites apply.

claims.claim: Users can share an agent with a Microsoft Teams team.
claims.quote: With this feature, users will be able to share their agent with a Microsoft Teams team.

claims.claim: Users can search for and find teams in the agent sharing dialog.
claims.quote: Users can search for and find teams in the agent sharing dialog box.

claims.claim: Users can optionally notify the selected team's main channel that the agent was shared.

claims.claim: The notification provides team members an easy way to install and start using the agent.
claims.quote: and as an easy way to install and start using the agent.

claims.claim: General agent entitlement has a mixed licensing model, combining licensed access and usage-based access.
claims.quote:
Microsoft 365 with a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license
Usage-based billing (pay-as-you-go) - Tenants can enable agent access without a full license, with some limitations to agent configuration options. Consumption is measured in Copilot Credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The roadmap record names no licence for this feature.
claims.quote: With this feature, users will be able to share their agent with a Microsoft Teams team.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Agent Builder sharing page requires recipients to have the Microsoft 365 Copilot licence type needed for the configured capabilities.
claims.quote: Users can only add agents that are shared with them when they have the type of Microsoft 365 Copilot license required for accessing the capabilities configured in that agent.

claims.claim: Attempts to use an agent without the appropriate capability licence might result in an error.
claims.quote: If a user doesn't have the appropriate license for an agent's capabilities, attempts to use the agent might result in an error.

claims.claim: The prerequisites page says Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is available to all Microsoft 365 users.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is a broadly accessible AI chat interface that is available to all Microsoft 365 users.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go agent consumption is measured in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Usage-based billing (pay-as-you-go) - Tenants can enable agent access without a full license, with some limitations to agent configuration options. Consumption is measured in Copilot Credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: For pay-as-you-go users, usage billing applies to agents grounded in tenant data.
claims.quote: Usage billing applies to agents grounded in tenant data, while agents grounded in public data or instructions are free to use.

claims.claim: A price or meter specifically for the Teams-team sharing action is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams team" "sharing" "price" agent; "share agents to Teams" billing price license. Opened plugins/prerequisites, plugins/cost-considerations and Copilot Studio requirements-messages-management; none names a Teams-sharing action meter.

claims.claim: The organisation-wide sharing control is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Settings > Sharing.
claims.quote: Org-wide sharing: In Agents > Settings > Sharing, control who can share agents built in Agent Builder with the organization.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the sharing setting using an applyOnce baseline.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.claim: The Sharing control applies only to agents built with Agent Builder.
claims.quote: Sharing control only applies to agents built with Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder.

claims.claim: Selecting No users for organisation-wide sharing still allows sharing directly with individuals.
claims.quote: No users - Disable sharing at the org level, but users can still share directly with specific individuals.

claims.claim: Changes to the Agent Builder Sharing setting apply only to new sharing actions.
claims.quote: Changes to the sharing setting apply only to new sharing actions.

claims.claim: Existing shared agents remain accessible unless their sharing settings are manually updated.
claims.quote: Existing shared agents remain accessible unless you manually update their sharing settings.

claims.claim: All users is the default for Agent Builder organisation-wide sharing.
claims.quote: All users (default): Everyone can share agents with the organization.

claims.claim: The admin settings page lists All users, No users and Specific users for Sharing.
claims.quote: All users - All users can share their agents with others in your tenant. No users - Disable sharing at the org level, but users can still share directly with specific individuals. Specific users - Restrict broad sharing permissions to designated groups.

claims.claim: The control over who can access and install agents and plugins is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Settings > User access.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Settings > User access to manage your organization's agents and plugins.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply a user-access baseline in applyOnce mode.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors

claims.claim: User access is a general tenant control over users' or groups' access to and installation of agents and plugins.
claims.quote: Use User access to control how members of your organization access and install agents and plugins.

claims.where: controls[2]; summary; What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: No dedicated tenant UI or API switch is documented for Teams-team sharing or its main-channel notification.
claims.quote: Searched: agents sharing Teams team notification sharing switch; Graph Teams team agent sharing notification configuration switch; PowerShell Teams share agents notification sharing policy. Read agent-settings, utcm-agent-resources and both sharing pages; no dedicated switch.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft does not state that the organisation-wide Agent Builder Sharing setting governs this Teams-team sharing option.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams team" "agent" "sharing" "disable"; "share agents to Teams" "admin". Opened agent-settings, Agent Builder sharing and utcm-agent-resources: the resource explicitly controls sharing with everyone, not sharing with a Teams team.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in Microsoft Entra user role for applying these Agent resources.
claims.quote: AI Administrator is the least-privileged role for the signed-in user for remediation and applyOnce; don't assign that user-role requirement to the service principal.

claims.claim: For applyOnce, the TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, grant it the CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated permission.

claims.claim: These TCM Agent resources are preview APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.
claims.quote: This article lists the Agent resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: The Agent resources support applyOnce, which applies the baseline once rather than merely monitoring.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce.

claims.claim: The sharing baseline resourceType is microsoft.agent.sharing.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.agent.sharing"

claims.claim: Sharing uses userAssignmentCategory with allowed values everyone and noOne.
claims.quote: userAssignmentCategory | Write | String | Specifies whether all users or no users can share agents with everyone in the organization. | everyone, noOne

claims.claim: The user-access baseline resourceType is microsoft.agent.useraccess.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.agent.useraccess"

claims.claim: The useraccess resource accepts userAssignmentCategory values everyone and noOne.
claims.quote: userAssignmentCategory | Write | String | Specifies whether all users or no users can access agents and plugins. | everyone, noOne

claims.quote:

Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility

claims.quote:
July 01, 2026
Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio

claims.claim: The July release note tells users to open the agent sharing dialog in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: Open the agent sharing dialog in Copilot Studio.

claims.claim: The Agent Builder sharing dialog lets an owner enter a name, group or email.
claims.quote: In the share dialog, enter a name, group, or email in the Add a name, group, or email box.

claims.claim: Agent Builder uses Can edit and Can chat as its two sharing access levels.
claims.quote:
Can edit | Owner — full rights to edit, share, and manage the agent.
Can chat | Chat user — can interact with the agent only.

claims.claim: A group added to an Agent Builder agent can only be Can chat, not an owner.
claims.quote: You can't add a group as an owner. When you add a group, it can only be a chat user (Can chat). To grant owner rights, add individual users.

claims.claim: The new Copilot Studio sharing experience documents individual users, security groups and the whole organisation as sharing audiences.
claims.quote:
For each agent, you can share with:
- Individual users by using their email or user name
- All members within security groups that you specify
- Your entire organization

claims.claim: Neither cited sharing page describes the specific Teams-team picker and main-channel notification.
claims.quote: Searched: agents sharing Teams team notification sharing switch; "Teams team" "agent" "role" sharing dialog. Read plugins/agent-builder-share-manage-agents and microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent in full; neither describes this option.

claims.claim: The role granted specifically by the Teams-team sharing option is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams team" "agent" "role" sharing dialog. Read both cited sharing pages and the two release-note entries. Agent Builder documents Can chat for groups, but no text identifies the role granted by this specific team picker.

claims.claim: Agent access and knowledge-source access are separate; sharing an agent alone does not grant all source-content access.
claims.quote: Access to an agent and access to its knowledge sources are distinct:

claims.claim: Existing file permissions and sensitivity labels apply to the Agent Builder agent's SharePoint and OneDrive sources.
claims.quote: SharePoint and OneDrive sources: Existing file permissions and sensitivity labels apply. Sharing the agent alone doesn't grant access to all its source content.

claims.claim: Files uploaded from a device become embedded knowledge.
claims.quote: Uploaded files: Files uploaded from a device become embedded knowledge.

claims.claim: Anyone with agent access can receive responses grounded in uploaded knowledge, subject to the embedded content's sensitivity-label permissions.
claims.quote: Anyone who can access the agent can receive responses grounded in that content, subject to the embedded content's sensitivity-label permissions.

claims.claim: A team's main channel is a shared collaboration space rather than a list of individually addressed recipients.
claims.quote: A Teams channel is a dedicated space within a team where members can engage in conversations, share files and collaborate on projects.

claims.claim: The roadmap description describes sharing and notification, not new agent actions.
claims.quote: Users can search for and find teams in the agent sharing dialog box. Users can also send a notification to the main channel of that team

claims.claim: The prerequisites page allows users in pay-as-you-go tenants to access agents without a full Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Users can access Copilot Chat and agents without a full Copilot license.

claims.claim: The new Copilot Studio sharing page requires recipients to have a Microsoft Copilot Studio per-user licence.
claims.quote: Users you share with have a Microsoft Copilot Studio per-user license. Users who don't have a license can sign up for a trial.

claims.claim: Agent Builder documentation says automatic SharePoint file and folder sharing is supported only with specific security groups.
claims.quote: Auto sharing SharePoint files and folders is only supported when sharing with specific security groups and not everyone in the organization.

claims.claim: No licence requirement specific to the Teams-team sharing option is published, distinct from general agent licensing.
claims.quote: Searched: "share agents to Teams" billing price license; "Teams team" "sharing" "price" agent. Read release notes, both sharing pages, plugins/prerequisites, agent-builder and cost-considerations; no separate team-picker entitlement.

claims.claim: Directly shared agents need not have undergone the admin review required for organisation-catalog publication.
claims.quote:
Publishing to your org catalog requires admin approval.
Sharing and catalog submission are separate paths.
